entries.title: A crewmate fixing failed checks stops when a try shows nothing new, not after three
entries.body: When a pull request's checks fail because of its own change, the crewmate keeps fixing them while each try shows something new, instead of always stopping after three tries. Once a try shows nothing new, it stops and tells you what blocks it, naming every try. A limit you set yourself still applies.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a crewmate stops fixing failed checks and what its report names, not a view or control.
